description: This PHP file defines the AOR_Report class, which is part of the SuiteCRM module for creating and managing custom reports. It includes methods for building SQL queries, generating HTML reports and CSV exports, handling report configurations, and managing relationships with other entities. The class extends Basic and implements report-specific functionalities such as report chart building, grouping, and permissions. It also references multiple external modules and utilities related to SuiteCRM and SugarCRM frameworks.

classes.name: AOR_Report
classes.description: Represents a custom report entity within SuiteCRM, providing mechanisms for query creation, report rendering, chart integration, and CSV export. Handles relationships, access control, and dynamic SQL generation to facilitate flexible reporting features.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the parent save method to include additional logic for saving report-related fields, conditions, and charts.

methods.name: build_report_chart
methods.description: Generates HTML code for embedded report charts using various libraries based on specified chart type.

methods.name: buildMultiGroupReport
methods.description: Recursively constructs a grouped report HTML interface with nested levels and data aggregation.

methods.name: build_group_report
methods.description: Builds an HTML report for a specific group, including pagination and expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: build_report_html
methods.description: Creates an HTML table with report data, supporting pagination, sorting, and total calculations.

methods.name: build_report_csv
methods.description: Exports the report data as a CSV file, handling field formatting and relations.

methods.name: build_report_query
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query string for retrieving report data, considering filters, groupings, and joins.

methods.name: build_report_query_select
methods.description: Adds SELECT components to the report query based on report fields and relationships.

methods.name: build_report_query_join
methods.description: Generates JOIN clauses for related tables in the report's SQL query, supporting relationship and custom joins.

methods.name: build_report_access_query
methods.description: Generates access control WHERE clauses for related modules.

methods.name: build_report_query_where
methods.description: Builds the WHERE clause for the report query based on filters and conditions.

methods.name: getReportFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields linked to the report, ordered by display sequence.

methods.name: getTotalHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for total summaries of report columns.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates aggregate totals such as SUM, AVG, or COUNT for report columns.

methods.name: encloseForCSV
methods.description: Escapes and encloses a field value for CSV output.
